Marta (People Ops): Quick heads-up: new streamlined medical leave documentation process and reminder about paid PTO for vaccine appointments. TL;DR below.
Marta (People Ops): Effective today: 1) Short-term medical leave (<=10 days) can be approved with manager attestation + one supporting doc uploaded within 30 days. 2) Vaccine/medical appointments up to 4 hours are paid and auto-approved in the HR portal. 3) We added a confidential submission option for sensitive health matters.
Ibrahim: So managers can attest for urgent cases and we don't need a doctor's note immediately?
Marta (People Ops): Correct. Manager attestation allows immediate approval; follow-up docs due in 30 days. No retaliation for delays.
Keisha: How about intermittent leave for chronic conditions?
Marta (People Ops): Intermittent leave requires a brief medical confirmation; reach out to Benefits for accommodations. We'll publish the flow chart in #people-ops-resources.
Benefits Bot: Checklist: 1) Submit medical leave request 2) Manager attestation or doc upload 3) People Ops review for >10 days 4) Confidential flag available. Link: https://redwood-internal/hr/med-leave
Liam: Appreciate faster handling. When's the FAQ update?
Marta (People Ops): Live by EOD. We'll host a 15-min AMA tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks!
